machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

compatibility_adapter.reason: The checkpoint is a generic MLX export, not an mflux-saved checkpoint, and its model card provides no inference command.
changes: preserve uint32 affine-packed weights instead of converting them to bf16
map weight, scales, and biases for quantized transformer and text-encoder modules
accept language_model.model as an alternative Qwen3-VL text-stack prefix
map the generic export's modulation.0 and time_text_embed.linear_* aliases
do not transpose VAE convolution kernels already stored in MLX layout
compatibility_adapter.intentionally_skipped: Qwen3-VL vision tower, lm_head, and twelve video-only VAE time_conv tensors

case.prompt: A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.

measurement.scope: Fresh process start through local model loading, tokenization and text encoding, 40-step denoising, VAE decode, and completed PNG output.
measurement.cache_state: The process had no resident model or compiled graph, but prior compatibility smoke tests had warmed the macOS filesystem cache.

command: /usr/bin/time -lp mflux-generate-qwen-2.1 --model <local-snapshot> --base-model qwen-image-2.1 --prompt 'A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.' --width 256 --height 256 --steps 40 --guidance 1 --seed 42 --no-metadata --output <output.png>
interpretation: This is a real end-to-end process measurement for the downloaded MLX checkpoint, not only denoising GPU time. It is directly comparable in prompt, size, steps, guidance, and seed to the documented native arbitrary-prompt smoke run, but differs in quantization policy and runtime implementation.
